Embedding request via Google Vertex AI using the vertex_ai/ provider prefix and the text-embedding-005 model — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_embed_async(client, "{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"vertex_ai/text-embedding-005\"}")
IO.inspect(result.data)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.data, 0).embedding)
```
